verdict.rationale: Grok's API and CLI are inherently natural-language driven — conversation, tool calling (web search, code execution, custom functions, MCP), and agentic workflows are all invoked via NL prompts per xAI docs, and community reports (e.g. using 'Grok Build' CLI conversationally) corroborate this in practice. missing for 10: deeper independent verification of NL command robustness beyond scattered forum comments.
